b4ae119d62ce32fc74b9cde7.title: Year 3 teaching-assistant provision
b4ae119d62ce32fc74b9cde7.summary: The 21 September letter explains the teaching-assistant arrangements for 2026/27.
points: Mrs Hummel works across both Year 3 classes, supporting guided groups, practical activities and Key Stage 2 routines. Specialist SEN support is provided where needed.
The school says the change is an educational decision, not a cost-saving measure, and apologises for not explaining it beforehand.
Provision will be kept under review, with additional resources provided if monitoring shows they are needed. No reply or deadline is requested.
b4ae119d62ce32fc74b9cde7.evidence: Letter to Year 3 Parents.pdf, pages 1–2; both pages read.

989658e78cff6c0a5877365a.title: Year 3 PSHEE and relationships education
989658e78cff6c0a5877365a.summary: The curriculum letter covers relationships, living in the wider world, and health and wellbeing. Years 1–3 revisit topics each year to build understanding.
points: Curriculum questions can be raised with Mrs Walsh or the class teacher.
The parent consultation closed on 25 September; it is not a current deadline.
989658e78cff6c0a5877365a.evidence: KS1 and KS2 PSHEE RSHE Letter 2026.pdf: letter and FAQ text read. Image-only curriculum overview not transcribed; no topic-by-term claims made.

1faa3ceffa714b82241b7a92.title: Year 3 prefects and leadership roles
1faa3ceffa714b82241b7a92.summary: Every Year 3 child will have a turn as a prefect, allocated randomly each term. Duties include helping younger children, holding doors and helping lead an assembly that parents will be invited to.
points: The September letter invited Digital Leader applications to the class teacher; it did not give a deadline. Current availability has not been confirmed.
The School Council deadline (11 September) and House Captain presentations (18 September) have passed. Eco-Council application details were to follow.
1faa3ceffa714b82241b7a92.evidence: Leadership Opportunities Letter Sept 26.pdf, pages 1–3 read; Year 8 roles excluded.

c69d4079eae36bab9a21db1f.title: Year 3 arrival and wraparound care
c69d4079eae36bab9a21db1f.summary: Year 3 enters through Lockington Grove between 8.25am and 8.45am. Parents may take children to their classroom door.
points: Breakfast Club is at Rookwood on King Edward Road; no booking is required for Reception–Year 8. Breakfast finishes at 8.10am. Staff escort Reception–Year 3 to Chadlington House at 8.25am.
Year 3 after-school care is at Rookwood. Use the current booking form in Thursday Communications; the form in this September welcome letter was for the first week only.
c69d4079eae36bab9a21db1f.evidence: Letter to Parents Welcome to Michaelmas Term.pdf, pages 1–2 read.

f6fb06efc6b8157506c26f5d.title: Harvest Festival · Year 3 · Friday 16 October
f6fb06efc6b8157506c26f5d.summary: 9am in Chadlington Hall. Parents are invited to the Pre-Preparatory Harvest Festival, which includes Year 3.
points: Donations support Caring Hands in Chatham: tinned soup, beans, tomatoes, vegetables, tuna or meat; rice, pasta, lentils, cereal or porridge oats; tea, coffee, biscuits or sugar.
Also in the newsletter: Firework Night is Thursday 5 November on the Paddock. The school event page lists 6.30pm; ticket details are still to follow.
The advertised orchestra is for Years 8–13, not Year 3. The older pupils’ Harvest services on 12 and 13 October are not Year 3’s service.
f6fb06efc6b8157506c26f5d.evidence: 9 October newsletter HTML and Harvest, Fireworks and Orchestra image notices read. Fireworks event page read. Year 3 / Pre-Preparatory mapping verified on school website. Principal video and portal weekly letters not reviewed.
